actual_fy.description: Actual private new capital expenditure by CAPEX industry and type of asset, FY2016-17 to FY2025-26: the sum of the four quarters of the original series (5625.0, ABS Data API CAPEX). asset: total, buildings_structures or equipment_plant_machinery. anzsic: the ANZSIC 2006 division or subdivision a CAPEX industry corresponds to (null for aggregates such as P95). flags: the ABS's quality flags on any of the quarters (x = an estimate has a relative standard error of 10% to 25%; z = over 50% (too unreliable for general use)).
